pages.title: A Warm Welcome
pages.text: Captured heat opens hot recipes; modest brass and copper support their next application.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Native capture accepts a Blaze or supported spawner. Ordinary fuel provides heat; Blaze Cake enables stronger heat where recipes require it.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an empty burner on a Blaze or its spawner, then feed the captured burner fuel. Provide industrial Basin heat; Blaze Cake produces a stronger heat state.
